facts.fact: University of Botswana researchers used CHIRPS satellite rainfall and CHIRTS satellite-derived temperature data (25 km) to compute drought indices and test them against national crop-yield data for agricultural drought monitoring in Botswana.

systems.platform: satellite-derived gridded rainfall and temperature data

facts.fact: University of Botswana researchers used CHIRPS satellite rainfall estimates (1981-2024, 25 km) to regionalise Botswana into drought zones and recommended building Nino 3.4 and SOI indices into national drought forecasting and early-warning systems.
